achievements.page_subtitle: Catalogue: rules, tiers and points. Achievement points become bricks; penalties reduce them.
achievements.recalc_hint: Recalculation runs after each lesson check. Use this button after backdated edits — it does not create duplicates; lessons already used for an achievement tier are not counted again.
achievements.rules_note: Streak: one streak grants each tier once; after a break, tiers can be earned again. Review lessons do not count in verse or test streaks. Point changes apply only to future awards. Achievement bonuses do not count toward «One hundred bricks» — only lesson points.
achievements.penalties_intro: Manual only, with a reason; teachers may reduce but not increase. Does not change grades, streaks or analytics — only bricks.
achievements.reward_dialog_hint: Pick a rule type — no programming required.
achievements.penalty_dialog_hint: Penalties are issued manually only. New values apply to future penalties.
achievements.field_tiers_hint: Empty tiers are ignored. New points apply only to future awards.
achievements.field_max_points_hint: Teachers may issue fewer, not more.
achievements.flag_off: Achievements and penalties are disabled in school settings
achievements.kind_locked: Rule kind cannot change after the first award or penalty
achievements.practice_cannot_enable: Voice practice will be enabled in a later wave

settings.page_subtitle: Shared for the whole school: interface language and time zone.
settings.language_hint: Applies to every user on the next page load.
settings.timezone_hint: IANA time zone for schedules and dates (ADR-004).
settings.footer_note: Changing the time zone does not recalculate past records — it applies to new operations.
settings.timezone_invalid: Enter a valid IANA time zone

school.page_subtitle: Active school year snapshot (scaffold; averages land in P05).
school.scaffold_note: Group tables and “Needs attention” lists arrive in later phases.

approvals.page_subtitle: New users completed registration and gave consent. Approve the request and assign roles.
approvals.footer_note: Incomplete registrations (no consent) are not listed here and are removed after 30 days — see Users.
approvals.empty_description: When someone submits a request, it will appear here.
approvals.approve_description: Assign roles and groups for the new user.
approvals.reject_description: Enter a reason — the user will see it if they resubmit.
approvals.already_decided: This request has already been decided. Refresh the list.
approvals.parent_unavailable: Parent access is not available yet.
approvals.parent_link_required: Choose how to link the parent to children.
approvals.parent_name_required: Enter the applicant's name before approving as a parent.
approvals.no_groups_warning: Teacher approved without groups. Assign a group later.
approvals.groups_invalid: One or more groups are not part of the active school year.

users.page_subtitle: All accounts. Each row opens the user profile.
users.registration_footer_note: Signed in but did not give consent or submit a request. Removed automatically 30 days after first sign-in.
users.disable_confirm_description: The user cannot sign in until access is enabled again.
users.enable_confirm_description: The user can sign in again when their status allows it.
users.merge_description: All data will move to the kept account.
users.last_admin: Cannot remove or disable the last administrator.
users.self_forbidden: You cannot perform this action on your own account.
users.merge_same: Choose two different users to merge.
users.merge_admin_forbidden: Elevate the kept user to administrator before merging an admin account.

year.empty_description: Create a year and activate it to manage groups and lessons.
year.activate_confirm_description: Only one year can be active. Lessons can be created in the active year.
year.close_confirm_description: Teachers will have read-only access to this year's data. This cannot be undone.
year.active_exists: An active school year already exists
year.status_invalid: This action is not allowed for the year's current status

group.empty_description: Create the first group for the active or draft year.
group.empty_no_year_description: Add and activate a school year, then create groups.
group.language_confirm_description: Verse texts in all group lessons will use the new translation. Saved scores will not change.
group.no_teachers_available: No available users with the teacher role
group.language_unavailable: English Bible translation is not ready yet
group.name_taken: A group with this name already exists
group.age_range_invalid: Minimum age cannot exceed maximum age
group.settings_max_verses: Enter a verse count from 0 to 10

people.empty_description: Create a student card to start enrollment.
people.legacy_list_description: Students imported from the previous app who still need guardian consent on paper.
people.legacy_extend_description: Set a later date for all migrated students. A reason is recorded in the audit log.
people.legacy_deadline_not_extended: Choose a date after the current deadline
people.consent_not_legacy_pending: This student is not in transitional consent status
people.enroll_description: Choose a group and start date
people.unenroll_description: Set the last day in the current group
people.transfer_description: Close the current enrollment and open a new one
people.birth_date_in_future: Birth date must be in the past
people.consent_date_in_future: Consent date cannot be in the future
people.already_enrolled: Student is already enrolled — use transfer
people.not_enrolled: Student is not enrolled in a group

audit.page_subtitle: Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.empty_description: Change filters or wait for new events.
audit.history_empty_description: Recent actions for this entity will appear here.

deletions.page_subtitle: Due within 15 calendar days of the request. Unlinked data is deleted; linked records are anonymised.
deletions.reject_description: The author will see the reason
deletions.execute_summary: Will delete {deleteCount} records and anonymise {anonymizeCount}. One transaction; cannot be undone.
deletions.child_request_title: Create a child data deletion request?
deletions.child_request_description: On guardian request. An administrator will complete it within 15 days.
deletions.guardian_note_label: Who contacted (no names in the audit log)
deletions.status_invalid: The request changed — refresh the page
deletions.self_execute: Another administrator must execute this request
deletions.warning_teacher_assigned_active_year: Teacher is assigned to an active-year group — replace first
deletions.warning_incomplete_homework_checks: Lessons with incomplete homework checks remain
